question: Which of the following is used to remove formatting from a selected paragraph in many word processing programs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Clear Formatting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Clear Formatting** is the option used to remove formatting from a selected paragraph in many word processing programs.
 
• This option strips away any applied styles such as bold, italics, font size, and color, returning the text to the default formatting.
 
• It is often found in the 'Home' tab of word processing software like Microsoft Word or Google Docs.
 
• Using **Clear Formatting** ensures that the text retains only plain text attributes without any additional styling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delete Paragraph** would remove the entire paragraph, not just its formatting.
 
• **Format Painter** is used to copy formatting from one part of the document to another.
 
• **Remove Paragraph** is not a standard option in word processing programs.
 
• Always ensure to save your document before making formatting changes to avoid accidental loss of important styling.
